title.zh: 李录 · 作品阅读导读
title.en: Li Lu · Collection guide

lead.zh: 李录是喜马拉雅资本创始人兼董事长。1997 年创立公司后，一直管理其主要基金；他在哥伦比亚大学同时取得 BA、JD 和 MBA 三个学位。
lead.en: Li Lu is the founder and chairman of Himalaya Capital. He has managed its principal fund since founding the firm in 1997, after earning BA, JD and MBA degrees simultaneously at Columbia University.

paragraphs.zh: 研究到真正理解，等待到机会足够好，再把资本交给优秀企业和时间。能力圈决定在哪里挥棒，安全边际决定何时挥棒。
paragraphs.en: Understand the business deeply, wait for an exceptional opportunity, then give the business and compounding time to work. Competence defines where to swing; a margin of safety defines when.

paragraphs.zh: 李录的作品适合沿着经历与方法两条线阅读。较早的访谈说明他的成长和时代背景；序言、投资访谈与大学演讲，则帮助理解他如何把企业研究、能力圈和长期持有连接起来。阅读时不要只记住“长期”这个词：更值得追问的是，企业竞争优势能否持续、研究凭什么形成确信，以及在哪些问题上投资者必须承认自己不知道。宏观环境与单个企业也要分开理解，不能把演讲中的长期方法直接套成某一季度交易的原因。
paragraphs.en: Read Li Lu along two threads: personal experience and investment method. Earlier interviews provide biographical context; forewords, investment interviews and university speeches illuminate business research, competence and long-term ownership. Go beyond remembering the word patience: ask why an advantage might endure, what supports conviction and what remains unknown. Keep the macro setting separate from an individual business, and do not turn a general investment principle into an explanation of a particular quarterly trade.

paragraphs.zh: 深度研究：穿透财务报表，理解行业格局、竞争优势和管理层；研究到能说清楚企业如何赚钱，也能说清楚自己不知道什么。
paragraphs.en: Deep Research: Understand the financials, industry, competitive advantage and management. Be able to explain how the business earns money—and what remains outside your knowledge.

paragraphs.zh: 集中持仓：把资金集中在少数真正理解、有足够安全边际的机会里；长期等待，也要在好球出现时敢于挥棒。
paragraphs.en: Concentrated Portfolio: Concentrate on a few deeply understood opportunities with a margin of safety. Wait patiently, then swing decisively at an exceptional pitch.

paragraphs.zh: 长期视角：用多年经营成果检验判断，让优秀企业的增长与复利发挥作用，不被短期报价牵着走。
paragraphs.en: Long-Term View: Let years of business results test the thesis and allow growth and compounding to work, without being driven by short-term quotes.

paragraphs.zh: 安全边际：以显著低于内在价值的价格买入。
paragraphs.en: Margin of Safety: Buying well below intrinsic value.

paragraphs.zh: 能力圈：清楚知道自己理解什么、不理解什么。
paragraphs.en: Circle of Competence: Invest only where you have a genuine edge.

paragraphs.zh: 在对的地方钓鱼：找到自己能钓到鱼的水域。
paragraphs.en: Fish Where the Fish Are: Focus where you can catch fish.

paragraphs.zh: 可以先读早期作品，再对照近期访谈或演讲，记录判断的前提、企业背景和后来发生的变化。先理解提问与回答的关系，再比较相同问题在不同年份的表达；不要把不同年份的材料拼接成一段从未说过的话。下面列出的篇目来自当前目录，目录仍可能遗漏公开作品。
paragraphs.en: Start with earlier works and compare later interviews or speeches, retaining assumptions, business context and subsequent changes. Read each answer with its question before comparing years. Do not splice separate works into a statement never made. The selections below come from the current catalogue, which may omit public material.

title.zh: 帕伯莱 · 作品阅读导读
title.en: Pabrai · Collection guide

lead.zh: Mohnish Pabrai 是 Pabrai Investment Funds 创始人及管理合伙人，也是 Pabrai Wagons Fund 的组合经理。首只 Pabrai 基金于 1999 年启动。
lead.en: Mohnish Pabrai founded Pabrai Investment Funds and is its managing partner. He also manages the Pabrai Wagons Fund; the first Pabrai fund launched in 1999.

heading.zh: Dhandho：正面我赢，反面我也输不了多少
heading.en: Dhandho: Heads I Win, Tails I Don’t Lose Much

paragraphs.zh: 先把可能失去的算清楚，再寻找足够大的上行空间。Cloning 帮他寻找好想法，清单与独立研究决定哪些想法值得投入。
paragraphs.en: Understand what could be lost before looking at the upside. Cloning supplies ideas; checklists and independent research decide which deserve capital.

paragraphs.zh: 帕伯莱的特色是把复杂的投资问题讲成容易记住的框架，但记住口号只是开始。“正面我赢，反面我也输不了多少”要求先研究下行情景：资产和现金流能提供什么保护、坏结果会不会造成永久损失，再考虑上行空间。Cloning 是寻找线索的方法，不能代替独立核查；清单也不是打勾仪式，而是防止自己重复犯错的工具。不同年份的访谈可以互相对照，关注一个想法经过实践后，哪些假设被修正，而不是只摘录最后的结论。
paragraphs.en: Pabrai makes difficult investment questions memorable, but a slogan is only the beginning. Dhandho starts with the downside: what assets and cash flows protect capital, and which bad outcomes could cause permanent loss? Cloning supplies leads rather than replacing independent verification. A checklist guards against repeated mistakes instead of merely recording boxes ticked. Compare interviews across time to see which assumptions were revised through experience, rather than collecting conclusions without their conditions.

paragraphs.zh: 正面我赢，反面我也输不了多少：Dhandho 核心——寻找高度不对称的赌注。
paragraphs.en: Heads I Win, Tails I Don’t Lose Much: Core Dhandho principle — asymmetric bets with limited downside.

paragraphs.zh: 50 美分买 1 美元：买入显著低于内在价值的股票。困境反转是最爱的狩猎场。
paragraphs.en: Buy $1 for 50 Cents: Purchase well below intrinsic value. Distressed turnarounds are the favorite hunting ground.

paragraphs.zh: 清单投资法：受 Atul Gawande 启发，严格的买入前检查清单。
paragraphs.en: Checklist Investing: Rigorous pre-investment checklists to avoid cognitive biases.

paragraphs.zh: 克隆大师：不羞于复制顶级投资者的最佳想法。
paragraphs.en: Clone the Best: Copy the best ideas of top investors. Cloning is a wonderful strategy.

paragraphs.zh: 极度集中：把资金集中在少数研究充分的机会中；具体持仓数量以当期披露为准。
paragraphs.en: Ultra-Concentrated: Concentrate capital in a few thoroughly researched opportunities; the actual number of holdings depends on the reporting period.

paragraphs.zh: 耐心等待：大部分时间什么都不做，只在最佳击球区挥棒。
paragraphs.en: Patience: Do nothing most of the time. Only swing in your sweet spot.

paragraphs.zh: 可以先读早期作品，再对照近期访谈或演讲，记录判断的前提、企业背景和后来发生的变化。先理解提问与回答的关系，再比较相同问题在不同年份的表达；不要把不同年份的材料拼接成一段从未说过的话。下面列出的篇目来自当前目录，目录仍可能遗漏公开作品。

title.zh: 段永平 · 作品阅读导读
title.en: Duan · Collection guide

lead.zh: 段永平是从企业经营走向投资的企业家，曾领导小霸王，后创立步步高。在雪球上，他以“大道无形我有型”分享对生意、管理和投资的理解。
lead.en: Duan Yongping is an entrepreneur who moved from operating businesses into investing. He led Subor and later founded BBK, and shares his views on business, management and investing on Xueqiu as 大道无形我有型.

heading.zh: 买股票就是买公司；不懂不做

paragraphs.zh: 经营者的经验帮助理解生意，能力圈约束行动。先问企业如何持续赚钱，再问价格；“不做空、不借钱、不懂不做”划清边界。
paragraphs.en: Operating experience helps explain a business, while competence constrains action. Understand enduring economics before price, with clear boundaries around borrowing, shorting and unfamiliar businesses.

paragraphs.zh: 段永平的访谈要结合经营者经验来读。“买股票就是买公司”意味着先理解产品、客户、商业模式和企业文化，再讨论价格是否合适。师生问答往往围绕具体问题展开，单独摘出一句回答容易丢掉前提；阅读时应把提问和回答一起保留在理解中。“不懂不做”不是降低研究要求，而是划清不能靠猜测跨越的边界。涉及股票、看涨期权、看跌期权的表达还要分别理解，不能把期权义务自动写成已经完成的现货买卖。
paragraphs.en: Read Duan through his operating experience. Buying a stock as a business means understanding products, customers, economics and culture before discussing price. In student Q&A, a short answer often depends on the question that prompted it; keep both in view. Staying within competence sets a research boundary rather than lowering the standard of evidence. Distinguish shares, calls and puts, because a derivative obligation is not automatically a completed cash-equity trade.

paragraphs.zh: 买股票就是买公司：把股票当作整家公司来评估，看生意本质而非报价波动。
paragraphs.en: Buy Companies, Not Stocks: "Buying stocks is buying companies" — evaluate businesses as if buying the whole company.

paragraphs.zh: 三不原则：不做空，不借钱，不懂不做——坚守能力圈，拒绝诱惑。
paragraphs.en: Three Don’ts: Don’t short, don’t use margin, don’t invest in what you don’t understand (不做空，不借钱，不懂不做).

paragraphs.zh: 长期集中：对理解深刻的企业保持耐心，集中程度来自研究和判断，不来自对短期行情的预测。
paragraphs.en: Long-Term Concentration: Be patient with deeply understood businesses. Concentration should follow research and judgment rather than a forecast of short-term prices.

paragraphs.zh: 能力圈：只投真正理解的生意，能解释赚钱的逻辑，也知道哪些问题自己答不上来。
paragraphs.en: Circle of Competence: Invest only in businesses whose economics you understand, and recognize the questions you cannot answer.

paragraphs.zh: 生意本质优先：先看商业模式、护城河、管理层，再看价格。
paragraphs.en: Business First: Focus on business model, competitive moat, and management quality before price.

paragraphs.zh: 师从巴菲特：追随巴菲特和芒格的理念，2006 年亲历巴菲特慈善午餐。
paragraphs.en: Learn from the Best: Follow Buffett’s and Munger’s principles. Met Buffett at the 2006 charity lunch.

paragraphs.zh: 可以先读早期作品，再对照近期访谈或演讲，记录判断的前提、企业背景和后来发生的变化。先理解提问与回答的关系，再比较相同问题在不同年份的表达；不要把不同年份的材料拼接成一段从未说过的话。下面列出的篇目来自当前目录，目录仍可能遗漏公开作品。

title.zh: 大卫·泰珀 · 作品阅读导读
title.en: David Tepper · Collection guide

lead.zh: 大卫·泰珀于 1993 年创立 Appaloosa。此前于 1978 年取得匹兹堡大学学位，1982 年获得卡内基梅隆 MBA，1985 年加入高盛。
lead.en: David Tepper founded Appaloosa in 1993. He graduated from Pittsburgh in 1978, earned his Carnegie Mellon MBA in 1982 and joined Goldman Sachs in 1985.

heading.zh: 在恐慌中算清生存概率

paragraphs.zh: 困境资产研究先看偿付能力、资产价值与生存机会，再看恐慌造成的错价。宏观、政策与流动性改变时，也要重新审视仓位。
paragraphs.en: Study repayment capacity, asset value and survival before panic-driven mispricing. Reassess positioning when policy, macro conditions and liquidity change.

paragraphs.zh: 泰珀的作品需要区分投资访谈与人生演讲。投资部分的关键通常是困境中的偿付能力、资产价值、政策和流动性：价格很低不等于损失很小，必须先理解企业能否活下来、资本结构中不同债权和股权承担什么风险。毕业演讲则提供个人经历和价值取向的背景，不应被当作一套交易规则。对照不同时点的采访时，应把当时的市场条件一起看，理解一个判断有哪些前提，以及环境变化后为什么需要重新检查。
paragraphs.en: Separate Tepper’s investment interviews from personal speeches. In distressed investing, repayment capacity, asset value, policy and liquidity matter: a low price does not by itself limit loss. Understand survival and the different risks borne by debt and equity. Commencement remarks provide personal context rather than a trading rulebook. When comparing interviews, retain their market setting so that a conditional judgment is not mistaken for a timeless instruction.

paragraphs.zh: 宏观视野：自上而下的宏观分析指导仓位。利率、经济周期和政策转向是核心驱动。
paragraphs.en: Macro Vision: Top-down macro analysis guides portfolio positioning. Interest rates, economic cycles, and policy shifts drive decisions.

paragraphs.zh: 集中押注：高确信度的集中持仓。当逻辑足够强，就下大注。
paragraphs.en: Concentrated Bets: High conviction positions in a focused portfolio. When the thesis is strong, bet big.

paragraphs.zh: 危机中的错价：恐慌会把风险与机会同时放大。分清价格崩跌与企业永久受损，研究仍有生存能力的困境资产。
paragraphs.en: Mispricing in a Crisis: Panic can magnify both risk and opportunity. Distinguish a price collapse from permanent business impairment and study the prospects for survival.

paragraphs.zh: 积极交易：宏观形势变化时迅速调整仓位。不是纯粹的买入持有型投资者。
paragraphs.en: Aggressive Trading: Willing to reposition quickly when the macro picture changes. Not a buy-and-hold purist.

paragraphs.zh: 深度尽调：对每个仓位进行深入研究。了解生意、数据和风险。
paragraphs.en: Deep Due Diligence: Intensive research on every position. Understand the business, the numbers, and the risks.

paragraphs.zh: 风险管理：把下行情景、偿付能力和仓位大小一起评估；投资前先想清楚判断出错时会损失什么。
paragraphs.en: Risk Management: Evaluate downside scenarios, repayment capacity and position size together. Understand the potential loss before committing capital.

paragraphs.zh: 可以先读早期作品，再对照近期访谈或演讲，记录判断的前提、企业背景和后来发生的变化。先理解提问与回答的关系，再比较相同问题在不同年份的表达；不要把不同年份的材料拼接成一段从未说过的话。下面列出的篇目来自当前目录，目录仍可能遗漏公开作品。

title.zh: 韦伯 · 作品阅读导读
title.en: Webb · Collection guide

lead.zh: 大卫·韦伯（David Webb，1965–2026）是香港企业管治及小股东权益倡导者，创办 Webb-site.com，2026 年 1 月 13 日去世。
lead.en: David Webb (1965–2026) founded Webb-site.com and advocated corporate governance and minority-shareholder rights in Hong Kong. He died on 13 January 2026.

paragraphs.zh: 把财务研究、股权网络与公司治理放在一起，让公开信息成为小股东也能使用的工具。投资研究与透明市场，是同一份坚持的两面。
paragraphs.en: Bring financial research, ownership networks and governance together so public information becomes useful to minority shareholders. Investment research and market transparency reinforce one another.

paragraphs.zh: 韦伯的公开研究把企业价值、股权关系和治理问题放在一起。阅读时可以先确定事实链：哪份公告支持哪项判断，谁控制公司，关联交易怎样影响小股东，管理层的利益是否与公众股东一致。“阳光是最好的消毒剂”在这里指向信息透明的价值，而不是一条估值公式。访谈能够解释他的研究取向，具体公司的结论仍应回到原始公告、财报和当时的股权结构。历史研究不能直接当成今天仍然持有某只股票的证明。
paragraphs.en: Webb links business value, ownership networks and governance. Start with the evidence chain: which filing supports a claim, who controls the company, how related-party transactions affect minority investors and whether incentives align. Sunlight expresses the value of transparency rather than a valuation formula. Interviews explain his approach, while company-specific conclusions require contemporary filings and ownership records. Historical research does not establish a present holding.

paragraphs.zh: 法证式研究：深入财务报表，发掘管理层不愿让你看到的问题。
paragraphs.en: Forensic Research: Deep-dive into financial statements. Uncover issues management won't show you.

paragraphs.zh: 逐字细读：逐行阅读申报文件，交叉比对关联交易。
paragraphs.en: Read Every Word: Read filings line by line. Cross-reference related-party transactions.

paragraphs.zh: 阳光是最好的消毒剂：透明度是公司治理不善的终极解药。
paragraphs.en: Sunlight as Disinfectant: Transparency is the ultimate remedy for corporate misgovernance.

paragraphs.zh: 捍卫小股东：为小投资者争取权益。
paragraphs.en: Minority Shareholder Rights: Fight for the small investor.

paragraphs.zh: 小盘价值投资：被低估、被忽视的港股小型股是狩猎场。
paragraphs.en: Small-Cap Value: Undervalued, overlooked HK small-caps are the hunting ground.

paragraphs.zh: 公开研究：公开分享研究成果。知识自由流通时最有力量。
paragraphs.en: Open Research: Share findings publicly. Knowledge is most powerful when it's free.

paragraphs.zh: 可以先读早期作品，再对照近期访谈或演讲，记录判断的前提、企业背景和后来发生的变化。先理解提问与回答的关系，再比较相同问题在不同年份的表达；不要把不同年份的材料拼接成一段从未说过的话。下面列出的篇目来自当前目录，目录仍可能遗漏公开作品。

title.zh: 巴菲特 · 作品阅读导读
title.en: Buffett · Collection guide

lead.zh: 沃伦·巴菲特长期领导伯克希尔·哈撒韦，被称为“奥马哈先知”。他的投资道路从格雷厄姆的低估值方法出发，在芒格的影响下，更重视优秀企业、持久竞争优势和长期复利。
lead.en: Warren Buffett led Berkshire Hathaway for decades and is known as the Oracle of Omaha. Starting with Graham’s valuation discipline, he came to place greater weight on outstanding businesses, durable advantages and long-term compounding, influenced by Charlie Munger.

paragraphs.zh: 从格雷厄姆的估值纪律走向优秀企业的长期复利。现金创造能力、管理层与资本配置共同决定一家企业能否值得长期拥有。
paragraphs.en: Combine Graham’s valuation discipline with long-term ownership of outstanding businesses. Cash generation, managers and capital allocation determine the case for enduring ownership.

paragraphs.zh: 巴菲特的资料应按年份连续阅读，而不是只收集名言。年会问答中的回答对应当时的问题、企业和资本配置环境；同一主题在不同年份的变化，往往比孤立的一句结论更有意义。阅读企业价值时，要分清会计利润、可分配现金、再投资需求和买入价格；阅读管理层时，则要看激励、诚信与资本使用方式。好的企业不自动等于任何价格都值得买，耐心持有也不等于停止检查生意。年会中其他发言人的观点应与巴菲特本人区分。
paragraphs.en: Read Buffett chronologically rather than collecting quotations. Annual-meeting answers respond to particular questions, businesses and capital-allocation conditions. Changes in a topic across years can be more informative than an isolated conclusion. Distinguish accounting earnings, distributable cash, reinvestment needs and price, and examine management incentives and integrity. A good business is not attractive at every price, while patience does not remove the need to reassess its economics. Identify other meeting speakers separately.

paragraphs.zh: 买入优秀企业：以合理价格买入具有持久竞争优势的企业。
paragraphs.en: Buy Wonderful Businesses: Buy companies with durable competitive advantages at fair prices.

paragraphs.zh: 安全边际：永远不要多付。价格与内在价值的差距是你的保护。
paragraphs.en: Margin of Safety: Never overpay. The difference between price and intrinsic value is your protection.

paragraphs.zh: 长期持有：我们最喜欢的持有期限是永远。让赢家持续复利。
paragraphs.en: Long-Term Horizon: Our favorite holding period is forever. Let winners compound.

paragraphs.zh: 能力圈：留在你理解的范围内。
paragraphs.en: Circle of Competence: Stay within what you understand.

paragraphs.zh: 企业主思维：像企业主一样思考，而非股票交易员。
paragraphs.en: Owner's Mindset: Think like a business owner, not a stock trader.

paragraphs.zh: 大量阅读：持续阅读年报与商业历史，让知识、判断力和经验一起积累。
paragraphs.en: Read Everything: Read annual reports and business history continuously, allowing knowledge, judgment and experience to accumulate.

paragraphs.zh: 可以先读早期作品，再对照近期访谈或演讲，记录判断的前提、企业背景和后来发生的变化。先理解提问与回答的关系，再比较相同问题在不同年份的表达；不要把不同年份的材料拼接成一段从未说过的话。下面列出的篇目来自当前目录，目录仍可能遗漏公开作品。

title.zh: 查克·阿克瑞 · 作品阅读导读
title.en: Chuck Akre · Collection guide

lead.zh: Chuck Akre 创立的 Akre Capital Management 成立于 1989 年。其公开方法以商业模式、管理者及高回报再投资机会构成“三条腿的凳子”。
lead.en: Chuck Akre founded Akre Capital Management in 1989. Its three-legged framework examines businesses, managers and reinvestment opportunities.

paragraphs.zh: 卓越的生意、可信的管理层、持续的高回报再投资机会。三条腿一起支撑复利机器；缺少任何一条，都需要重新审视长期价值。
paragraphs.en: An exceptional business, trustworthy managers and opportunities to reinvest at high returns. Together they support a compounding machine; a missing leg demands a fresh appraisal.

paragraphs.zh: 阿克瑞的“三条腿的凳子”适合拆开研究，再重新放在一起：生意本身是否优秀，管理层是否诚实且善于配置资本，企业是否还有能够获得较高回报的再投资机会。高回报率只是起点，如果赚到的钱无法继续高效投入，长期复利的空间就会收窄。阅读访谈时，可以关注他如何判断某条腿受损，以及为什么价格波动与生意质量的变化不是同一件事。这个框架的价值在于提供连续的检查顺序，不是把所有高 ROIC 公司直接选出来。
paragraphs.en: Take Akre’s three-legged stool apart and then reconnect it: exceptional economics, trustworthy capital allocators and opportunities to reinvest at attractive returns. A high return alone is insufficient when future reinvestment opportunities disappear. Look for how interviews distinguish a damaged business leg from a moving market quotation. The framework supplies a sequence for continued appraisal, rather than automatically approving every company with a high historical return on capital.

paragraphs.zh: 三条腿的凳子：卓越商业模式 + 优秀管理层 + 再投资机会。
paragraphs.en: Three-Legged Stool: Extraordinary business + excellent management + reinvestment.

paragraphs.zh: 复利机器：寻找能持续以高回报率再投资利润的企业。
paragraphs.en: Compounding Machines: Find businesses that reinvest at high rates of return.

paragraphs.zh: 集中投资：把研究精力放在真正理解的企业上，用经营质量支持长期持有。
paragraphs.en: Concentration: Focus research on well-understood businesses whose quality supports long-term ownership.

paragraphs.zh: 长期持有：耐心持有优质企业，同时持续核对经营与最初的判断是否一致。
paragraphs.en: Long Holding Periods: Own quality businesses patiently while checking that operations continue to support the original thesis.

paragraphs.zh: 资本回报率：看企业能否持续取得高资本回报，也看增长需要投入多少新资本。
paragraphs.en: Returns on Capital: Examine both the durability of returns on capital and the additional capital required for growth.

paragraphs.zh: 管理层至上：诚实、能干、善于资本配置的管理层。
paragraphs.en: Management First: Honest, capable, skilled capital allocators.

paragraphs.zh: 可以先读早期作品，再对照近期访谈或演讲，记录判断的前提、企业背景和后来发生的变化。先理解提问与回答的关系，再比较相同问题在不同年份的表达；不要把不同年份的材料拼接成一段从未说过的话。下面列出的篇目来自当前目录，目录仍可能遗漏公开作品。

title.zh: 格伦·格林伯格 · 作品阅读导读
title.en: Glenn Greenberg · Collection guide

lead.zh: 格伦·格林伯格是 Brave Warrior Advisors 的管理董事和首席投资官，以集中研究和长期价值投资著称。
lead.en: Glenn Greenberg is managing director and chief investment officer of Brave Warrior Advisors, known for concentrated research and long-term value investing.

heading.en: A Focused Set of Good Businesses

paragraphs.zh: 把研究集中在真正理解的企业上，让竞争地位、现金流和资本回报互相印证。公司治理最终也会落到长期股东的回报上。
paragraphs.en: Concentrate on understandable businesses, checking competitive position, cash generation and returns on capital together. Governance also shapes long-term shareholder outcomes.

paragraphs.zh: 格林伯格的公开访谈适合围绕“为什么少数企业值得投入大量研究”来读。集中持仓提高了每个判断的重要性，因而需要同时理解竞争地位、客户关系、现金流与资本回报，不能用单一便宜指标代替企业研究。阅读时要把容易理解的商业模式与容易预测的经营结果分开：企业看起来简单，仍可能受到竞争、定价和管理层资本配置的影响。公开作品较少时，更应保留采访的上下文，不把其他作者对他的评价冒充本人的完整观点。
paragraphs.en: Greenberg’s interviews are useful for asking why a small set of businesses deserves intensive research. Concentration raises the importance of each judgment, requiring competitive position, customer economics, cash generation and returns on capital to be considered together. An understandable model is not necessarily a predictable outcome. Competition, pricing and capital allocation still matter. When primary material is sparse, retain context and distinguish the investor’s own statements from commentary about him.

paragraphs.zh: 极度集中：少数深入理解的企业，比一长串浅尝辄止的想法更值得投入研究。
paragraphs.en: Extreme Concentration: A focused set of deeply understood businesses deserves more attention than a long list of shallow ideas.

paragraphs.zh: 高 ROIC：关注资本回报的质量与持续性，核对利润能否转化为现金。
paragraphs.en: High ROIC: Study the quality and durability of returns on capital and whether profits turn into cash.

paragraphs.zh: 强护城河：寻找具有持久竞争优势和定价权的企业。
paragraphs.en: Strong Moats: Durable competitive advantages and pricing power.

paragraphs.zh: 优秀管理层：管理层必须诚实、能干、以股东利益为重。
paragraphs.en: Excellent Management: Honest, capable, shareholder-aligned.

paragraphs.zh: 逆向买入：在市场恐慌时敢于大举买入。
paragraphs.en: Contrarian Buying: Buy aggressively during panics.

paragraphs.zh: 长期持有：耐心持有优质企业，同时持续核对经营与最初的判断是否一致。
paragraphs.en: Long-Term Hold: Own quality businesses patiently while checking that operations continue to support the original thesis.

paragraphs.zh: 可以先读早期作品，再对照近期访谈或演讲，记录判断的前提、企业背景和后来发生的变化。先理解提问与回答的关系，再比较相同问题在不同年份的表达；不要把不同年份的材料拼接成一段从未说过的话。下面列出的篇目来自当前目录，目录仍可能遗漏公开作品。

title.zh: 塞斯·克拉曼 · 作品阅读导读
title.en: Seth Klarman · Collection guide

lead.zh: Baupost 于 1982 年成立。Seth Klarman 自公司成立以来负责投资，现任 CEO 和组合经理；其团队也包括总裁 Jim Mooney。
lead.en: Baupost was established in 1982. Seth Klarman has overseen investments since inception and is CEO and portfolio manager, working alongside president Jim Mooney.

paragraphs.zh: 保守估值，给判断错误留下余地；没有足够好的机会，就愿意持现等待。Baupost 的机会跨越多类资产，股票披露只是其中一扇窗口。
paragraphs.en: Value conservatively and leave room for error; wait in cash when opportunities are insufficient. Baupost’s multi-asset mandate extends beyond the equity filing.

paragraphs.zh: 克拉曼的作品以保全资本和安全边际为阅读主线。首先理解他所说的风险：不是报价是否波动，而是哪些情景会使资本永久受损，以及投资者有没有能力熬过这些情景。保守估值、现金、流动性与仓位大小应一起讨论；看上去便宜的资产，如果需要额外投入或短期融资，也可能没有足够保护。阅读公开访谈时，要保留判断的条件，不能把逆向理解成与市场唱反调，也不能把耐心理解成忽略错误。
paragraphs.en: Use capital preservation and margin of safety as the thread through Klarman’s work. Ask which outcomes could permanently impair capital and whether the investor can withstand them. Conservative appraisal, cash, liquidity and position size belong together. A seemingly cheap asset may offer little protection if it requires further funding. Preserve the conditions attached to a judgment: contrarian investing is not simply disagreement, and patience is not refusal to recognize a mistake.

paragraphs.zh: 安全边际：永不多付：只在价格显著低于保守估计的内在价值时买入。
paragraphs.en: Margin of Safety: Never overpay. Always buy at a significant discount to conservatively estimated intrinsic value.

paragraphs.zh: 无机会时持现：宁愿持有大量现金，也不强行将资金投入平庸的机会。
paragraphs.en: Hold Cash When Idle: Willing to hold large cash positions rather than force capital into mediocre ideas.

paragraphs.zh: 绝对收益优先：以保全资本为优先，而非追求相对于基准的表现。
paragraphs.en: Absolute Return Focus: Prioritize capital preservation over relative benchmark performance.

paragraphs.zh: 深入的基本面研究：每一仓位背后都是严谨、独立的分析。
paragraphs.en: Deep Fundamental Research: Rigorous, independent analysis before every position.

paragraphs.zh: 逆向自律：愿意提前、孤独地下注，避免集体心理。
paragraphs.en: Contrarian Discipline: Willing to be early and alone; avoid crowd psychology.

paragraphs.zh: 保持低调：很少接受采访，让业绩自己说话。
paragraphs.en: Low Public Profile: Rarely gives interviews; lets results speak.

title.zh: 比尔·阿克曼 · 作品阅读导读
title.en: Bill Ackman · Collection guide

lead.zh: Bill Ackman 创建并领导 Pershing Square 投资机构。集团采用长期、集中投资方式，也可能运用对冲；旗下投资载体各有独立披露。
lead.en: Bill Ackman founded and leads Pershing Square. The group uses long-term concentrated investing and may employ hedges; its vehicles have separate disclosures.

heading.zh: 买企业，也推动企业变好

paragraphs.zh: 简单、可预测、自由现金流，是选择生意的起点；集中持有与股东行动，则是推动价值实现的方法。对冲也需要放在组合背景里理解。
paragraphs.en: Simple, predictable cash-generative businesses are the starting point. Concentrated ownership, active engagement and portfolio hedges form the wider approach.

paragraphs.zh: 阿克曼的作品可以把企业分析与推动价值兑现两条线分开看。前者解释商业模式、竞争优势、现金流和估值；后者涉及治理、资本配置、董事会与可能的变化路径。一个投资判断可能依赖经营结果，也可能依赖外部行动，二者需要不同的证据和时间尺度。访谈中的失败复盘尤其适合检验最初假设、执行难度和风险控制，但不能把事后成功总结成事前必然。不同阶段的投资方法也应按作品日期区分。
paragraphs.en: Separate Ackman’s business analysis from his efforts to realize value. One concerns economics, competition, cash and valuation; the other concerns governance, capital allocation, boards and possible change. These require different evidence and time horizons. Discussions of setbacks help test assumptions, execution and risk control, but a successful outcome is not proof it was inevitable in advance. Keep the date and stage of his approach attached to each work.

paragraphs.zh: 简单、可预测的企业：寻找能产生自由现金流、拥有持久竞争优势的公司。
paragraphs.en: Simple, Predictable Businesses: Free-cash-flow generative companies with durable competitive advantages.

paragraphs.zh: 维权介入：推动改选董事会、更换管理层或调整战略方向。
paragraphs.en: Activist Engagement: Push for board seats, management changes, and strategic shifts.

paragraphs.zh: 极度集中：持仓集中，因此每一项投资都需要深入研究和足够强的判断。
paragraphs.en: Ultra-Concentrated: A concentrated portfolio requires deep research and strong conviction behind each investment.

paragraphs.zh: 非对称对冲：使用期权与信用对冲工具防范尾部风险。
paragraphs.en: Asymmetric Hedges: Uses options and credit hedges to protect against tail risk.

paragraphs.zh: 公开分享逻辑：乐于在社交媒体上详细分享投资逻辑。
paragraphs.en: Public Thesis-Sharing: Openly shares detailed investment cases on social media.

paragraphs.zh: 耐心资本：愿意为一个逻辑充分展开而持有多年。
paragraphs.en: Patient Capital: Willing to hold for years for a thesis to play out.

title.zh: 大卫·艾布拉姆斯 · 作品阅读导读
title.en: David Abrams · Collection guide

lead.zh: David Abrams 于 1999 年创立 Abrams Capital，现任 CEO 和组合经理。公司总部位于波士顿。
lead.en: David Abrams founded Abrams Capital in 1999 and is its CEO and portfolio manager. The firm is based in Boston.

paragraphs.zh: 低调不是缺少判断，而是把精力留给研究。用灵活的资本跨越公开与私人市场，为真正理解的价值机会留出时间。
paragraphs.en: Keep attention on research rather than publicity. Flexible capital spans public and private markets, giving understood value opportunities time to develop.

paragraphs.zh: 艾布拉姆斯的公开资料较少，阅读重点应放在已经公开的研究过程，而不是替他补写投资故事。套利经历、通才式研究、基本面判断和确信度可以相互联系：广泛寻找机会并不意味着对每个行业都已有答案，投资者仍需知道哪些问题能核实、哪些变量难以估计。访谈中的退出、仓位与管理层讨论，应结合具体提问理解。节目说明只能帮助定位话题，不能替代完整录音，更不能据此推断没有公开的持仓动机。
paragraphs.en: Abrams has relatively little public material, so focus on the process he has actually discussed rather than filling in a private investment story. Arbitrage experience, generalist research, fundamentals and conviction can be connected without assuming expertise in every industry. Understand which questions are verifiable and which variables resist estimation. Read discussions of exits, sizing and management with their questions. Programme descriptions locate topics but do not substitute for a full recording or reveal undisclosed motivations.

paragraphs.zh: 集中研究：把资本和研究精力投入少数充分理解的机会，仓位应与风险和确信度相匹配。
paragraphs.en: Focused Research: Commit capital and attention to well-understood opportunities, sizing positions to risk and conviction.

paragraphs.zh: 安全边际：延续 Baupost 风格：买入价显著低于内在价值。
paragraphs.en: Margin of Safety: Baupost-style discipline: buy well below intrinsic value.

paragraphs.zh: 极度低调：几乎不对外发声，13F 申报是外界了解其思路的主要窗口。
paragraphs.en: Extreme Privacy: Almost no public statements; 13F filings are the main public signal.

paragraphs.zh: 深入、独立的研究：投资前做好独立研究，用企业事实检验判断。
paragraphs.en: Deep, Independent Research: Research independently and test the thesis against business facts.

paragraphs.zh: 长期持有：换手率低，耐心复利。
paragraphs.en: Long Holding Periods: Low turnover, patient compounding.

paragraphs.zh: 信念决定仓位大小：仓位大小与对逻辑的确信程度直接相关。
paragraphs.en: High Conviction Sizing: Position size scales directly with confidence in the thesis.

paragraphs.zh: 可以先读早期作品，再对照近期访谈或演讲，记录判断的前提、企业背景和后来发生的变化。先理解提问与回答的关系，再比较相同问题在不同年份的表达；不要把不同年份的材料拼接成一段从未说过的话。下面列出的篇目来自当前目录，目录仍可能遗漏公开作品。

title.zh: 布鲁斯·伯科威茨 · 作品阅读导读
title.en: Bruce Berkowitz · Collection guide

lead.zh: Bruce Berkowitz 是 Fairholme 的创始人及投资负责人。官方基金文件注明，他自管理公司 1997 年成立起担任 CIO，并负责基金的日常组合管理。
lead.en: Bruce Berkowitz founded Fairholme. Official fund documents state that he has been CIO since the manager’s inception in 1997 and is responsible for portfolio management.

heading.zh: 跟着现金走，看穿账面价值
heading.en: Follow the Cash & Look Through Book Value

paragraphs.zh: 把现金创造能力、土地与经营资产的价值算清楚。集中与逆向需要研究支撑，账面便宜不是充分理由，价值如何兑现同样重要。
paragraphs.en: Assess cash generation and the value of land and operating assets. Concentration and contrarian judgment require research; low book multiples alone are insufficient.

paragraphs.zh: 伯科威茨的作品要同时看现金和资产。土地、经营资产与账面价值提供了估值线索，但真正的问题是价值怎样变成股东能够获得的现金、需要等待多久，以及实现过程中会消耗多少资本。集中和逆向增加了对研究与耐心的要求，不能把账面折价本身当成结论。比较不同年份的访谈时，可以检查原先设想的资产处置、经营改善或资本配置是否按预期推进；企业有价值与投资回报能够及时兑现，是两个需要分别核实的问题。
paragraphs.en: Read Berkowitz through both cash and assets. Land, operating assets and book value offer clues, but ask how value becomes distributable cash, how long realization may take and what capital it consumes. Concentration and contrarian positioning require evidence and patience, rather than treating a book discount as a conclusion. Compare interviews against the progress of asset sales, operating improvements and capital allocation. Business value and timely investment realization are distinct questions.

paragraphs.zh: 实物资产价值：深入分析底层土地与房地产资产价值。
paragraphs.en: Real Asset Value: Deep analysis of underlying land and real-estate asset value.

paragraphs.zh: 深度资产研究：穿透账面数字，研究土地、经营资产和现金流真正能实现的价值。
paragraphs.en: Deep Asset Research: Look beyond book figures to the realizable value of land, operating assets and cash flows.

paragraphs.zh: 逆向耐心：只要逻辑未变，即使年年遭质疑仍愿持有。
paragraphs.en: Contrarian Patience: Holds through years of skepticism when the thesis is intact.

paragraphs.zh: 资产导向估值：以重置成本/资产价值估值，而不仅仅看盈余倍数。
paragraphs.en: Asset-Based Valuation: Values businesses on replacement/asset value, not just earnings multiples.

paragraphs.zh: 安全边际：仅在价格显著低于评估资产价值时买入。
paragraphs.en: Margin of Safety: Buys only when price is well below appraised asset value.

paragraphs.zh: 数十年视角：土地与实物资产的逻辑需要数十年才能充分展现。
paragraphs.en: Multi-Decade Horizon: Land and real-asset theses play out over decades, not quarters.

title.zh: 梅森·霍金斯 · 作品阅读导读
title.en: Mason Hawkins · Collection guide

lead.zh: Mason Hawkins 于 1975 年创立 Southeastern Asset Management，现任董事长及多个 Longleaf Partners 基金的共同组合经理。CEO 和研究负责人是 Ross Glotzbach。
lead.en: Mason Hawkins founded Southeastern Asset Management in 1975. He is chairman and co-portfolio manager of several Longleaf Partners funds. Ross Glotzbach is CEO and head of research.

paragraphs.zh: 像私人买家一样估算企业价值，寻找值得合作的管理层，再要求足够大的价格折让。积极参与资本配置，也是等待价值兑现的一部分。
paragraphs.en: Appraise the business as a private buyer, seek capable management partners and require a substantial discount. Engagement on capital allocation can help value realization.

paragraphs.zh: 霍金斯的“企业、管理者、价格”提供了清晰的阅读顺序。先像私人买家一样估算整个企业的经济价值，再判断管理层是否值得长期合作，最后检查报价是否留下足够折让。估值不应只看利润表，还需要理解资产、负债、现金创造能力和不同业务的价值。公开对谈也可帮助理解长期合伙文化与积极参与资本配置的关系。阅读时区分经营价值改善和市场价格回归，避免把任何一次上涨都当成最初估值已经被验证。
paragraphs.en: Hawkins’s business, people and price provide a reading sequence. Appraise economic value as a private buyer, assess management as a long-term partner and then examine the price discount. Consider assets, liabilities, cash generation and distinct businesses alongside earnings. Conversations also illuminate partnership culture and engagement on capital allocation. Distinguish improvements in economic value from a market re-rating; a rising quote does not automatically validate the original appraisal.

paragraphs.zh: 内在价值评估：像私人买家一样估算企业价值。
paragraphs.en: Intrinsic Value Appraisal: Estimate business value as a private buyer would.

paragraphs.zh: 以显著折价买入：目标是以显著低于评估内在价值的价格买入。
paragraphs.en: Buy at a Substantial Discount: Target a significant discount to appraised intrinsic value.

paragraphs.zh: 管理层能力：要求能干且与股东利益一致的管理团队。
paragraphs.en: Qualified Management: Require capable, aligned management teams before investing.

paragraphs.zh: 企业价值优先：穿透报表倍数看底层业务与资产价值。
paragraphs.en: Enterprise Value Focus: Look past headline multiples to underlying business and asset value.

paragraphs.zh: 集中研究、积极参与：深入理解企业，与管理层讨论资本配置和价值实现，而不只等待市场报价变化。
paragraphs.en: Focused Research & Engagement: Understand the business and engage with managers on capital allocation and value realization, rather than relying solely on market prices.

paragraphs.zh: 长期主义：耐心持有多年，等待价值充分实现。
paragraphs.en: Long-Term Discipline: Patient, multi-year holding periods for value to be realized.

title.zh: 罗布·维纳尔 · 作品阅读导读
title.en: Rob Vinall · Collection guide

lead.zh: Rob Vinall 于 2006 年创立 RV Capital，现任管理董事；Andreas Lechner 是共同管理董事。公司位于瑞士。
lead.en: Rob Vinall founded RV Capital in 2006 and is its managing director. Andreas Lechner is co-managing director. The firm is based in Switzerland.

heading.zh: 与理性的经营者做长期股东

paragraphs.zh: 企业、经营者和资本的时间尺度需要匹配。看十年后的生意、持续积累的竞争优势，以及管理层是否诚实、理性、与股东站在一起。
paragraphs.en: Align the time horizons of the business, managers and capital. Study durable economics, growing advantages and honest, rational managers aligned with shareholders.

paragraphs.zh: 维纳尔的资料适合把致投资人信和年度交流放在一起读。书面信件更容易看清当时如何解释企业、经营者和长期假设；问答则能补充这些判断受到怎样的质疑。关注管理层是否诚实、理性以及与股东利益一致，也要追问竞争优势能否积累、增长是否创造价值、企业如何重新投入现金。长期持有需要匹配企业和资本的时间尺度，并不意味着所有假设永远成立。不同年份的叙述应相互校验，避免把最新观点覆盖掉当时的原始条件。
paragraphs.en: Read Vinall’s investor letters alongside annual gatherings. Letters record how he explained businesses, managers and long-term assumptions at the time; Q&A adds the challenges put to those judgments. Examine honest, rational, aligned management together with durable advantages, value-creating growth and reinvestment. Long-term ownership requires compatible business and capital horizons, not assumptions that can never change. Compare years without overwriting earlier conditions with today’s explanation.

paragraphs.zh: 长期存续：评估企业十年后能否继续发展。
paragraphs.en: Durable Business: Assess whether the business can thrive a decade from now.

paragraphs.zh: 竞争优势：寻找持续积累长期竞争优势的企业。
paragraphs.en: Competitive Advantage: Look for a growing long-term competitive advantage.

paragraphs.zh: 管理层榜样：关注管理层是否以身作则、理性经营。
paragraphs.en: Management Example: Study management’s conduct and rationality.

paragraphs.zh: 有吸引力的价格：优秀企业也需要合理的买入价格。
paragraphs.en: Attractive Price: Require an attractive purchase price.

paragraphs.zh: 长期持有：满足投资标准后，以长期拥有为目标。
paragraphs.en: Long-Term Ownership: Invest with the intention to own for years.

paragraphs.zh: 集中研究：深入研究少数企业，用投资者信持续检验最初的判断与经营变化。
paragraphs.en: Concentrated Research: Study a focused set of businesses deeply, using investor letters to revisit the thesis and changes in operating performance.
